articles.headline: Supreme Court Voids Yes Bank's AT-1 Bond Write-Off
articles.brief: In a major legal development, India's Supreme Court has officially voided Yes Bank's $880 million AT-1 bond write-off, marking a significant ruling for financial markets and investors.

articles.headline: India Mutual Funds Stop Bulk Gold ETF Subscriptions
articles.brief: Indian mutual funds have abruptly halted bulk subscriptions to gold exchange-traded funds ahead of the festive season, signaling a strategic shift in institutional investment behavior amid fluctuating market conditions.

articles.headline: Wipro Deal Wins Plunge to Four-Year Low
articles.brief: Wipro has reported a sharp decline in major deal wins, hitting a near four-year low and raising fresh concerns among analysts regarding the company's turnaround strategy and long-term tech sector competitiveness.

articles.headline: Flipkart Alumni Press Walmart for Cash Buyout
articles.brief: Former employees and early stakeholders of Flipkart have renewed pressure on retail giant Walmart to facilitate a liquidity cash-out option, bypassing traditional initial public offering timelines.

articles.headline: US Lawmakers Outraged Over Foiled Hindu Temple Attack
articles.brief: US lawmakers have expressed deep outrage following the successful foiling of a planned attack against a Hindu temple in Illinois, prompting heightened security measures and expressions of solidarity.

articles.headline: PM Modi to Visit Canada in December
articles.brief: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to visit Canada on December 11-12, with bilateral discussions focusing heavily on strengthening economic ties, security cooperation, and diplomatic engagement.

articles.headline: US Considers Easing Sanctions on Shadow Fleet
articles.brief: The United States is weighing potential relief on sanctions linked to Russian and Iranian oil tankers to expand global shipping capacity and manage fuel costs ahead of upcoming mid-term elections.

articles.headline: Five Killed in Houthi Attack on Yemen's Palace
articles.brief: At least five people were killed and sixteen others injured following a targeted Houthi strike on the presidential palace in Yemen's interim capital of Aden, escalating regional security tensions.

articles.headline: Oregon Elementary School Shooting Leaves Four Dead
articles.brief: A tragic shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon, has left three children and a teacher dead, alongside the teenage suspect who was also found dead at the scene.

articles.headline: US States Sue OpenAI Over Child Safety Risks
articles.brief: Multiple US state attorneys general have filed lawsuits against AI giant OpenAI, alleging that its conversational chatbot poses direct mental health harms to children and deceives adult users.

articles.headline: AI Data Center Threatens Historic Chestnut Grove
articles.brief: Plans for a massive AI infrastructure data center in West Virginia threaten one of America's last remaining blight-resistant American chestnut groves, sparking resistance from local conservationists.

articles.headline: Suchika Tariyal Wins Asian Games MMA Bronze
articles.brief: Overcoming severe financial strain and selection hurdles, 36-year-old Suchika Tariyal secured an inspiring bronze medal in mixed martial arts at the Asian Games, culminating a remarkable multisport career.

articles.headline: Para-Shuttlers Challenge Selection in Delhi HC
articles.brief: Top Indian para-badminton players have filed a formal petition in the Delhi High Court challenging their exclusion from the upcoming Asian Para Games contingent despite meeting all established criteria.
